verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API covers core UI functions like tax rate calculation, transaction upload, nexus tracking, address/VAT validation and order creation (taxjar-docs-1, taxjar-gh-3/4/5/6), showing substantial parity for calculation-related workflows. However, key UI features like AutoFile (automated filing/remittance) and account/pricing management are only described as dashboard products with no evidence of corresponding API endpoints, and no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec exists (taxjar-probe-2 404), undermining full API-UI parity claims. Missing for 10: API endpoints for AutoFile/filing, account/subscription management via API, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec.
